headline: Phase 3 Cancer Vaccine Success Could Change The Case For Moderna Stock
summary: Moderna was recently added to the Nasdaq-100 Index after positive Phase 3 data for its personalized cancer vaccine with Merck highlighted a pivot toward oncology beyond COVID-focused products. The late-stage success of intismeran positions Moderna's mRNA platform as a potential multi-product franchise across cancer and other conditions rather than a single-therapy story.
